description: Repeated poly_bot trading admission failures caused by non-transient insufficient inventory.
filter: ((resource.type="gce_instance" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"message\":\"arbitrage admission blocked by insufficient inventory\"") OR (resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="arb-bot" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="arb-bot" AND resource.labels.container_name="arb-bot" AND jsonPayload.fields.message="arbitrage admission blocked by insufficient inventory" AND jsonPayload.fields.rebalance_transient=false))

labels.description: Trading pair whose admission was blocked.
Primary economic asset with insufficient available inventory.
Same-asset rebalance phase observed when admission was blocked.
